title: 2.5.20 A16.2 Game States
description: Add a state machine with at least three states to your W15 game — menu, play, win/lose, and a return-to-menu transition. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Declare a state variable
steps.instructions: At the top level (outside setup and draw), declare let gameState = 'menu'. This is the single variable that controls which part of the game is running.
hints: Open the q5play docs drawer on the right and find the State Machines section.

steps.title: Drive draw() with switch(gameState)
steps.instructions: Inside draw(), add switch(gameState) { ... } so that every state routes to its own case block. Add at least the case 'menu' block first.
hints: See 2.5.16 Reading — switch in draw() for the dispatch pattern.

steps.title: Implement three named cases
steps.instructions: Add case 'menu', case 'play', and at least one end state (case 'win' or case 'lose') inside the switch. Each case should render something different.
hints: Open the q5play docs drawer and look at the State Machines section for an example with multiple cases.

steps.title: Add an input-driven transition from menu to play
steps.instructions: Inside case 'menu', add an if(kb.presses(...)) block that sets gameState = 'play'. Use kb.presses (one-shot) not kb.pressing (held).
hints: See 2.5.18 Reading — Input-driven transitions for the kb.presses pattern.

steps.title: Add a condition-driven end transition
steps.instructions: Inside case 'play', add a condition (score check, lives check, or overlap check) that sets gameState = 'win' or gameState = 'lose' when the end condition is met.
hints: See 2.5.19 Reading — Condition-driven transitions for examples with score and lives.

steps.title: Add a return-to-menu transition
steps.instructions: From your win or lose case, add a way for the player to return to the menu — typically kb.presses on a key that sets gameState = 'menu'.
hints: Open the q5play docs drawer and find the State Machines section for the full loop pattern.

requirements.title: Declare a state variable
requirements.description: Declare let gameState = '...' with a string literal initializer at the top level.

requirements.title: Drive draw() with switch(gameState)
requirements.description: Inside draw(), use switch(gameState) to dispatch per-frame logic.

requirements.title: Implement at least three named cases
requirements.description: The switch contains at least three case '<label>': blocks.

requirements.title: Input-driven transition (menu → play)
requirements.description: Inside a case block, kb.presses(...) is followed by gameState = '...' to start the game.

requirements.title: Condition-driven end transition (play → win or lose)
requirements.description: Inside the play case, a game condition sets gameState to 'win' or 'lose'.

requirements.title: Return-to-menu transition
requirements.description: From a non-menu case inside draw(), the player can return to the menu by setting gameState = 'menu'.
